chapter: Struttin' Time, chronology and Chicago singers
title: "Dumb Luck" with Moss and Frye, her first Broadway show
summary: Her first Broadway show had the first Black showgirls, including Lena Horne's mother, and starred comedians Moss and Frye.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Let me get back to this. I must tell you this. The show -- the first show that I was in in New -- on Broadway -- we played Stamford, Connecticut -- was -- what was the name of that show? Wait now. I wonder -- didn't want to forget, because the first time they ever had colored showgirls, you
know, the tall girls that carry clothes. That's the show that Lena Horne's mother was in with me.
Wait now. What was the name? Dumb Luck.
Dumb Luck with Moss and Frye. I know you've heard of them. They were comedians. Moss was a straight man, and Frye was a comedian, and they were the biggest things in America at that time, comedians.
Now, this was before How Come?
Before, yes, this was before anything. That was the first Broadway show.
